Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents Christina Ellis in connection with injuries sustained in the motor vehicle collision that occurred on
2024-05-11. The available evidence establishes that your insured failed to stop at a controlled intersection and struck
our client's vehicle broadside. Police documentation of the scene, photographs of the damage, and witness
statements all point to the same conclusion: liability rests squarely with your insured.
Our client sought immediate medical care and has since underogne extensive treatment, including imaging, physical
therapy, and specialist consultations. A review by a qualified medical expert has concluded that our client suffers from
a permanent injury that will affect daily function and earning capacity for the foreseeable future. The treatment
records and the expert's written findings are enclosed for your review.
Based on the medical costs incurred to date, projected future care, lost income, and the permanent nature of the
injury, our client demands payment of $74,200.00 to resolve this claim.
You have thirty (30) days from the date of this letter to tender payment in full or to make a written settlement offer. If
we do not receive a satisfactory response within that period, we are prepared to file suit without further notice and to
seek all damages available unedr the law.
Please direct all communications regarding this matter to my office.
Sincerely,
Attorney of Record
Expert review: William Johnson, neurologist
Sincerely,
Garrett Wallace
Gardner & Morris Law Group

  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
